from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInventoryRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's inventory amount from its financial report for the period in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    inventory_amount: float | None = Field(description="The '存货' amount from the consolidated balance sheet, in yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the inventory amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_inventory_records: list[CompanyInventoryRecord]
